Comment: Automated Ransomware Containment & IR Orchestrator - Project 3 state machine. Triggered by a high-severity EDR webhook (via EventBridge or API Gateway) with the raw alert payload as input.

ParseAlert.Comment: Week 1: parse hostname, IP, user, process hash from the raw EDR alert

ContainmentInParallel.Comment: Week 2: isolate the host and suspend the identity at the same time to minimize dwell time

MergeContainmentResults.Comment: Collapses the Parallel state's array output back into a single event

ForensicCollection.Comment: Week 3, Day 1-3: KAPE / memory dump evidence collection

ChainOfCustody.Comment: Week 3, Day 7: SHA-256 hashing and chain-of-custody logging

EvidenceUpload.Comment: Week 3, Day 4-6: upload to hardened WORM S3 bucket

Ticketing.Comment: Week 4, Day 1-2: auto-generate Jira/ServiceNow incident ticket

Notification.Comment: Week 4, Day 3-4: Slack/Microsoft Teams alert to the on-call IR team

ResponseTimeReport.Comment: Week 4, Day 5-7: table-top/live simulation response-time measurement
